records.note: A 'Milliardenmarkt' for psychedelic medicines names no metric, no threshold and no published series. E-0104 is a rank in a named IQVIA series, a different claim. Rejection stands.
'The rollout speed will surprise everybody positively' is a comparative with no benchmark and no observable criterion. Rejection stands.

'Investors will be rewarded' gives no share price, no market capitalization and no date. The registry share-price events (E-0103, E-0028) each carry a threshold the words do not give. Rejection stands.
'Once-in-a-lifetime buying opportunity' is a slogan about a sector, with no index, no threshold and no named series. Rejection stands.
A reading of an FDA signal ('ready to act fast'), not a decision. No application, no regulatory action and no date. Rejection stands.

'Spravato is a blockbuster drug' is present tense. E-0092 reads 'blockbuster' as US$1 billion of annual sales, so the words state an outcome the forecaster treats as already reached on the statement date. The forward part is attributed ('projected to') and 'several billion' gives no threshold. KNOWN replaces VAGUE.

'A much more successful drug than Spravato' names no metric. E-0105 (BPL-003 annual sales at or above US$1 billion) carries a threshold the words do not give, and 'successful' is not an observable series. Rejection stands.
'The re-rating has only just begun' gives no price level and no date. E-0103 carries a threshold the words do not give. Rejection stands.
'Significantly outperform current analyst forecasts' names no forecast, no number and no series, in sales or in 'market leadership'. Rejection stands.

records.stage_note: Psychedelic compounds are in late-stage development or early regulatory review at the statement date; a first-line listing needs an approval and then a guideline revision. No class in base-rates.json covers a practice-guideline change.
records.note: First-line status for psychedelic compounds is the same asset and outcome type as E-0111, which the registry now holds, so the claim is recovered from the earlier VAGUE. E-0111 reads the weaker 'even preventative interventions' step as outside the criterion, so the claim is one record, not a split. 'I expect' sets bin B. 'Ultimately' and 'over time' are not deadlines, so the item is undated. A guideline body decides and none of the forecaster's affiliations is named in the event.
'Your favourite biotech stock in 2026' is a slogan and 'should' is a recommendation. No index, no threshold and no benchmark. Rejection stands.

records.stage_note: AtaiBeckley (Nasdaq: ATAI) is listed but is not a constituent of a major index named in the criterion at the statement date. No class in base-rates.json covers an index addition.
records.note: 'Major index inclusions' for AtaiBeckley is the same asset and outcome type as E-0059, which the registry now holds, so the claim is recovered from the earlier VAGUE. 'I expect' sets bin B. 'Over the coming months' is not a deadline, so the item is undated, as E-0059 already reads. The index provider decides, and the forecaster is co-founder and chairman of atai, which the event names, so affiliated is true.
'Could be viewed as analogous to a cardiovascular checkup' names no body, no guideline and no countable set. The 5 to 10 year window cannot make an unobservable outcome checkable. Rejection stands.
'Approval processes accelerate and become less costly' names no agency action, no review-time metric and no series. Rejection stands.
'Hundreds of millions of people' has no named series, and 'soon' is not a deadline. The registry holds no patients-treated event for the psychedelic class. Rejection stands.
'Paid for by the health care system' names no payer, no country and no product. E-0116 covers midomafetamine only, and E-0018 covers the Medicare add-on payment only. Rejection stands.
'Psychedelics could help people cope with a quicker changing world' names no treatment decision, no measure and no deciding body. Rejection stands.
'We are well on track' names no trial, no endpoint and no date; it reports progress of his own company. Rejection stands.
'Many psychedelic companies' is a quantifier with no countable set, and 'bring a product to market' names no company and no product. Rejection stands.
A curability claim plus a plan to prove it. No named trial, no endpoint and no date. Rejection stands.
'Wider legalization could push back the whole effort' names no law, no body and no observable setback. Rejection stands.
Mainly a claim about his own foresight. 'Medically available again' names no regulator, no product and no country. Rejection stands.
'Room for positive surprises' is market sentiment with no index, no threshold and no date. Rejection stands.
'Atai is worth much more' and 'investors will choose high-quality companies' give no price level and no benchmark. Rejection stands.

'Total addressable market of 100% of a population' and 'one of the most valuable companies in the world' name no series and no rank threshold. E-0104 is a rank of therapeutic areas in the IQVIA series, a different claim. Rejection stands.
'People will seek out psychedelic-assisted therapy' before a diagnosis names no count, no series and no date. Rejection stands.

'Massive pressure from patients' is not a guideline listing (E-0111) and not a prescription count (E-0124). No observable criterion, even with the 'a year or two after approval' window. Rejection stands.
'Every drug once approved is worth billions' names no drug, no sales series and no date. Rejection stands.
'MAPS and Compass will positively surprise' is a comparative with no benchmark and no named outcome. Rejection stands.
Patients asking for psychedelics first is not a guideline listing (E-0111) and not a prescription count (E-0124). No observable criterion. Rejection stands.
'Patients will demand it' and 'a fairly easy rollout' name no measure and no deciding body. Rejection stands.
'Have the potential' and 'could lead to increased patient access' name no trial, no endpoint and no access measure. Rejection stands.
'Much more scientific validation' names no trial, no endpoint and no publication, and 'very soon' is not a deadline. Rejection stands.

records.deadline_text: over time after approval by medical authorities
records.stage_note: Psilocybin drug products are in clinical development at the statement date, with no approved product dispensed in the named IQVIA series. No class in base-rates.json covers a prescription-volume comparison.
records.note: Psilocybin displacing classic antidepressants is the same asset and outcome type as E-0124, which the registry now holds, so the claim is recovered from the earlier VAGUE. 'Will likely' is a qualified 'will' and takes the qualifier's bin B. 'Over time' is not a deadline, so the item is undated. The approval clause is not coded as a separate condition, because E-0124 already resolves FALSE for a year with no dispensed psilocybin prescriptions. IQVIA publishes the series and none of the forecaster's affiliations is named in the event.
The 100% total addressable market claim names no series, no sales number and no threshold. Rejection stands.
'Great for atai' and 'a long-term change in sentiment' give no share price level and no benchmark. Rejection stands.
'Market penetration will outpace estimates' names no estimate, no series and no number. Rejection stands.
'Short-duration psychedelics will be especially important in driving access and scale' names no decision, no count and no deciding body. Rejection stands.
'Those who believe in a slow roll out will be very positively surprised' is a comparative with no benchmark. Rejection stands.
'It will massively pay off for patients and shareholders' gives no price level, no measure and no date. Rejection stands.
